_note: svelte2tsx takes every `<style>…</style>` in the file out of the template check, nested ones included (htmlxparser.ts finds them all with one regex and `handleStyleTag` removes them), while a nested `<script>` stays an element. So a `<style>` inside `<svelte:head>` or a `<div>` is not checked at all: its attributes are not typed and the names they read count as unused. We emitted it as `svelteHTML.createElement("style", …)`, which typed `media={level}` (TS2322) and counted `level` and `label` as read.
